notes.title: The soundtrack is now available free of charge!
notes.content:
[h3]We're offering this game's soundtrack free of charge to all purchasers!!! [/h3]
It contains 34 tracks used in the game, totaling 1 hour and 18 minutes of music in MP3 and high quality FLAC data. All purchasers can download it as DLC from the game's store page.

The song data will be downloaded in the Soundtrack folder of the game's installation folder, so please enjoy it with your music player.

notes.title: [Patch note: Ver. 1.17b4] New costumes implemented!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42336614/d21f0e993eba0c30e01e7069abf4b440568da09c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42336614/a75fe6562e1c174e38cfe669beb2244eab602c2b.jpg[/img]

[h2]- New costumes have been implemented! [/h2]
The gallant [b]Brave Knight[/b] and the dainty [b]Lumiere Dress[/b]. Both costumes can be obtained in the Dressing Room after defeating the bosses that appear after clearing the game at a certain difficulty level.

- Fixed issues that did not significantly affect game progression and display issues.
